decision: 2026-10-18 review: keep untouched rolls of the new material for validating the next base-estimation version; never read for development, threshold choice, failure analysis or fitting
source: BlueNeg release (https://huggingface.co/datasets/ttgroup/blueneg-release), via the group pack; credit 'Copyrighted by Tien-Tsin Wong'
caveat: all sealed rolls are Kodak Gold 100-5 from one 1996 trip: same photographer, scanner, conversion and film stock as dev rolls 199608B/D/I/J. A held-out set, not an independent population. Frames that exist elsewhere only as visually similar (non-identical) files are not detected; the original BlueNeg DNGs of these frames are frozen by name only if downloaded later.
